editorial:
If you loved the first Sonic movie, you're in for a treat because this sequel brings even more action and heart. Sonic is back in Green Hills, trying to prove he's a real hero, when Dr. Robotnik returns with a powerful new partner named Knuckles. The blue hedgehog teams up with Tails, a smart two-tailed fox, and they race across the world to find a magical emerald before it falls into the wrong hands. The vibe is fun, fast, and full of energy, with plenty of laughs for kids and adults alike. The story feels bigger and bolder, giving you more of the characters you already enjoy while adding fresh faces that fit right in.

The action scenes are a blast, especially the snowboarding chase and the final showdown. Jim Carrey steals every scene he's in as Robotnik, and the voice work for Sonic and Tails is spot on. The pacing moves quickly, though some jokes land better than others. Families will love it, and fans of video game movies will appreciate the nods to the games.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Sonic and Tails use the Master Emerald's power to stop Robotnik, who tries to use it to build a giant robot. Knuckles realizes Robotnik was using him and switches sides to help Sonic. The emerald shatters, and its pieces scatter across the world. In a post-credits scene, Robotnik's assistant Stone finds a secret file, and we see Shadow the Hedgehog waking up in a lab, setting up the next movie.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family adventure movies, video game adaptations, and lighthearted action comedies.
